To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the urn design yields the following: 1. a permutational null distribution that may be different from the distribution of the test statistic based on a population model (i.e., complete randomization); 2. an approximate permutational null test of treatment effect that is covariate-adjusted; and 3. a poststratified subgroup analysis based on the permutational null model.
(i) the urn design yields unbiased permutation tests of treatment effect and (ii) these tests may be different than those based on the randomization model.
In summary, our research is concerned with
statistical inference in clinical trials with the urn design.
statistical properties of the randomization model in clinical trials.
the statistical properties of the randomization procedure in clinical trials.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the urn design is a useful tool in the arsenal of clinical trialists and statisticians.
the urn design is the best randomization design for a small-sized clinical trial.
the urn randomization design is a good compromise between restricted and complete randomization.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the urn design is an excellent randomization procedure for clinical trials, especially for small trials.
, when the population model does not apply to the study population, the urn design provides a reasonable alternative for the randomization procedure in clinical trials.

the urn design has the following properties: (a) it is a compromise design that yields a balance in treatment assignments in a small trial but approaches complete randomizaton as the size of trial increases, (b) the urn design is robust to the violation of the randomization model and (c) the urn design can provide the basis for poststratification analyses.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the urn design is a powerful tool for clinical trial design and analysis.
the urn randomization design is a useful alternative to the complete randomization design for clinical trials.
, when the urn design is used for a clinical trial, the statistical inference based on the design should be performed using permutational tests and not on the basis of asymptotic normality.
